provenance.asset_description: Starfinder Society #1-04: The Great Absalom Relay. The cover is two images, a large background illustration and a smaller single character overlayed above that image. The background image is First Seeker Sarmak and fellow Starfinder Zizenzi fighting off robots in front of a massive, alien starship. It’s dark, and the Starfinders are illuminated by aerial spotlights from an unknown source. The top image is a boar with giant tusks and mechanical headpiece and right arm.
